lane: تَرَبَّلَ 5 see 1, in two places. ___ تربِّلت الأَرْضُ The land had trees such as are termed رَبْل; i. e. breaking forth with green leaves, without rain, when the season had become cool to them, and the summer had retired: (As, A'Obeyd, T:) or the land became green after dryness, at the advent of autumn. (S.) And تربّل الشَّجَرُ The trees put forth leaves such as are termed رَبْل. (M, K. *) === تربّل also signifies He ate رَبْل; (Ibn-'Abbád, K;) said of a gazelle. (Ibn-'Abbád, TA.) And They (a company of men) pastured their cattle upon رَبْل. (M, K.) And He prosecuted a search after رَبْل. (Ibn-'Abbád, K.) === Also He took, captured, caught, snared, or trapped; or sought to take &c.; game, or wild animals, or the like. (M, K.) You say, خَرَجُوا يَتَرَبَّلُونَ They went forth to take &c., or seeking to take &c., game &c. (M.)
